summary: Validated Render Docker lockfile-missing fix for both Yarn install branches, confirmed production-equivalent frontend build, and verified .dockerignore protections. No app feature retest performed by request.

minor.endpoint: Docker image build execution in workspace
minor.issue: Docker CLI/daemon unavailable (`docker: command not found`), so actual `docker build` image creation could not be executed here.

action_items: On Render, redeploy latest commit and verify build logs no longer show checksum failure for `/frontend/yarn.lock`.
Keep Root Directory blank and Docker Build Context `.` as documented in RENDER_SETUP.md.
If reproducibility is required, ensure `frontend/yarn.lock` is present in repo exports; fallback path is now validated when absent.
critical_code_review_comments: Dockerfile fix is structurally correct: `COPY frontend/ ./` removes hard dependency on lockfile presence at Docker COPY stage.
Conditional yarn install branches include required `--ignore-engines --network-timeout 120000`; with-lock branch correctly keeps `--frozen-lockfile`.
`.dockerignore` excludes `.env`, `node_modules`, and `build`, reducing secret/context leakage risk.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable fixtures outside project at /root/render-lock-check/{with-lock,no-lock}; no app DB seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed branch-equivalent commands exactly as Dockerfile logic: in with-lock fixture command used frozen lockfile and lock checksum matched source; in no-lock fixture command generated new yarn.lock successfully. Production-equivalent `yarn build` with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=/, GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false, DISABLE_EMERGENT_OVERLAY=true, ENABLE_HEALTH_CHECK=false compiled successfully. Docker CLI absent in workspace, so external Render build must be final proof.
rca of the issue: Render failed before because Dockerfile previously required `COPY frontend/yarn.lock` and BuildKit computes checksums for explicit COPY sources before RUN logic. If Render checkout/export lacks that file, build fails at cache-key/checksum stage. New Dockerfile copies whole `frontend/` first, then conditionally runs frozen install if lock exists else normal install that generates lockfile, preventing that pre-RUN COPY failure class.
